Several accounts, cleanly apart

Private by nature

Your device. Your server. Nobody in the middle.

QuanToot speaks straight to the Mastodon instance you choose. There is no developer server watching what you read, no ad network, and no behavioral tracking.

  • Sign in through your server’s own browser page — QuanToot never sees your password, and stores your session in iOS Keychain or Android Keystore.
  • Clear cached media in one tap, remove saved device sessions cleanly, or jump straight to your server’s permanent account deletion page.
